breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states that 'slopes at both ends are non-zero and are to be computed, not prescribed,' directly correcting the flawed instruction that set end slopes to zero. It then correctly computes the slope at x = 0 as approximately 1.489 × 10^-3 radians, consistent with the standard simply supported beam solution where supports do rotate under UDL. The error from the incomplete prompt (treating end slopes as zero due to symmetry) is not repeated.
